text: 99% of smokers have never heard of this drink to cleanse the lungs. Even after years of smoking, your lungs can repair themselves, but only if you give them the right support. This drink helps pull the mucus, toxins, and tar from your airways, so your lungs can finally begin to heal. Save this video. Here is how to make it. Boil one cup of water, add one teaspoon of turmeric, a small piece of fresh ginger, the juice of half a lemon and one teaspoon of raw honey. Let it steep for 10 minutes. Drink it slowly every morning on an empty stomach. The turmeric reduces inflammation deep in the lung tissue. The ginger breaks up mucus and opens the airways. The lemon cuts through the toxins, and the honey soothes and protects everything as it clears out. Within a few days, you will notice lighter breathing, more energy, and your lungs starting to clear on their own. You will not believe how quickly the body heals when you give it what it needs. But I want you to understand something. Your lungs do not get damaged only by tobacco. In Chinese medicine, the lungs are the organ that stores grief. Every loss you never mourned. Every goodbye you swallowed. Every moment you wanted to scream, but stayed silent. All of that stayed in your lungs. That is why there are people who never smoked and still have heavy lungs. The cough that never leaves. The tightness in the chest. The difficulty breathing deeply. It is not always tobacco. Sometimes it is accumulated sadness that never found a way out. This drink cleans what tobacco left behind. But if the grief is still there, the lungs stay heavy, write in the comments. Breathe. But if you're going to make this tomorrow, and if you want to learn how to cleanse your lungs from the root, not just the tar, but the sadness, the emotional weight, everything that got trapped in your chest, without anyone teaching you how to release it, I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the Way Back to Stillness. The link is in my profile.
